name: Mads Nielsen
bio:
Mads' culinary journey began in his grandmother's kitchen in Copenhagen, where he learned the art of traditional Danish cuisine. After formal training at a renowned culinary school, he spent several years honing his skills in high-end restaurants. His passion for motorsport ignited during a family trip to the Danish Grand Prix, sparking a desire to combine his culinary talents with the thrill of racing.

Mads joined Toyota Gazoo Racing BR with a mission to elevate the team's dining experience, ensuring that every meal is both nutritious and delicious. He is known for his meticulous planning, attention to detail, and ability to adapt to the demanding schedules of the racing world. His culinary creations are not just meals; they are strategic fuel for peak performance, a key element of the team's success.

What sets Mads apart is his commitment to sourcing the freshest, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. He believes in sustainability and strives to minimize waste, reflecting his deep respect for the environment and the traditions of his native Denmark. He's always experimenting with new flavor combinations and techniques, ensuring the team never has a dull meal.

physical.description: Mads is a sturdy man with a friendly face and focused expression.

quirks: Insists on brewing his own coffee blend, even on race days.
Secretly judges the nutritional value of every snack in the garage.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and flavor combinations.
